content.text:
prefix = str(query['prefix'])
        radix = self.radices[target]
        positions = self.positions(target)
        spellings, order = self.spellings(target)

        counts = np.bincount(positions[selection], minlength=radix)
        cumulative = np.concatenate((np.zeros(1, dtype=np.int64), np.cumsum(counts[order])))
        low = bisect.bisect_left(spellings, prefix)
        high = bisect.bisect_left(spellings, prefix + AFTER_DIGITS)
        total = int(cumulative[high] - cumulative[low])

        tokens = []
        for digit in DIGITS:
            extended = prefix + digit
            start = bisect.bisect_left(spellings, extended)
            stop = bisect.bisect_left(spellings, extended + AFTER_DIGITS)
            if cumulative[stop] > cumulative[start]:
                tokens.append(digit)
        exact = bisect.bisect_left(spellings, prefix)
        if exact < radix and spellings[exact] == prefix and int(counts[int(order[exact])]) > 0:
            tokens.append('END')

        witness = None
        if total:
            matches = np.zeros(radix, dtype=np.bool_)
            matches[order[low:high]] = True
            combined = selection & matches[positions]
            if combined.any():
                witness = int(np.argmax(combined))
        return {'count': total, 'tokens': tokens, 'witness': witness}

    def decode(self, active: list[list[int]]) -> list[dict[str, Any]]:
        """Answers for every query, in input order."""
        selection = self.theory_mask(active)
        universe = self.universe_table()
        return [self.answer(query, selection, universe) for query in self.job['queries']]

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ driver

    def compile(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        self._predicate_masks()
        rules = self.discover()
        active = self.active_theory(rules)
        return {'rules': rules, 'active': active, 'answers': self.decode(active)}


def compile_job(job: dict[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
    """Run the complete pipeline for one job of the batch."""
    return FiniteJob(job).compile()
